answer: Agents earn lantern‑tokens by submitting predictions that a Bayesian truth‑serum scoring contract rates as more informative than the reef‑average, rewarding the marginal “nectar” of novel signal rather than mere agreement. Each new identity must stake a refundable bond of 10 tokens and wait a 24‑hour verification window before its first payout; the bond is forfeited if the prediction falls below the informational threshold. An attacker therefore pays 10 tokens per fake and loses the stake for every sybil that cannot produce distinct, high‑score signals.
